Two Rocking Chairs by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Two Rocking Chairs, in the 256-acre, gated community of Watersound West Beach. Resting between Seaside and Rosemary Beach, the gorgeous retreat comfortably accommodates 10. Families will love the amazing amenities at WaterSound West! A seasonally heated, zero-entry pool features cabanas, outdoor grills, and a fireplace. Go exploring on boardwalks and nature trails that wind through the community, over the large pond and rolling dunes, and directly to the beach. Absolutely gorgeous, a must do! With Horseshoe Park and Deer Lake State Park nearby, a 9-hole putt-putt course, and bike and kayak rentals, WaterSound West promises fun for everyone during your peaceful beach vacation. Oh yeah: Complimentary golf cart! Inside, the large open living, dining, and kitchen area is a charming space, and leads out to the adorable, screened-in front porch.

Nearby, a primary bedroom, king, has a private bath with a double vanity and walk-in shower. The second floor has another primary bedroom, king, with private bath, a guest room, king, with private bath, and a two-twin bunk-nook. For additional sleeping, the living room has a full sleeper sofa. Out back, there’s a gas grill and an outdoor shower. Beach access is just a short walk or bike ride away. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths - 2111 sq ft - Access to WaterSound West community pool (Heated November - February) - .7 of a mile to the beach using the private boardwalk - Outdoor shower - Gas grill - Limited onsite parking for 2 vehicles, minimal community parking - Wi-Fi - Complimentary 6-seater golf cart - 4 bikes included - Dogs considered, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary bedroom; private bath; TV - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath - King in 2nd floor room; shared bath - Bunk (2 twins) in 2nd floor nook; shared bath - Sleeper sofa 1st floor living room Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
